description: The category tree: departments, the groups inside them, and the categories (leaves) that hold products. With no department, lists every department and its groups; with a department or group slug, lists what is inside it. Use popular_only for the popular categories shown on the site. Browse a category's products with get_category or list_products.

department.description: A department or group slug from an earlier list_categories call, to list what is inside it.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

name: list_categories

category_count.description: Categories inside a department or group.

level.description: department and group hold categories; only a category (a leaf) holds products.

title: List categories
